strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Princess Romina! We've arrived at the Mars base!
Heh, brings back memories.
Mars... We're back.
I've come back again... This time to fight...
No, to save Shiratori...!
Minato, match our altitude with the Elshank...
Oh, and Ruri, you take the helm too, okay?
Roger. Being put to convenient use, as always.
Minato's in sick bay, fine... but where has our sub-helmsman Erina
run off to?
At a crucial time like this... That'll count against her in her review!
...So this is... the Meganoid base... I never knew a place like this existed.
I know homecomings are nice... but we've got bigger things to deal with.
Master Banjo... the time has finally come?
...I'm off, Garrison.
Do take care, Master Banjo. Shall I have some champagne ready?
Yes. To celebrate the Meganoids' destruction
and Major Shiratori's full recovery. ...Let's go!
Daitaaarn! Come heeere!
Seizing a Meganoid base to save a man who used to be our enemy...
There's such a thing as being too good-natured.
Tetsuya! That's going too far!
Still, never thought we'd end up at the Meganoids' home base like this.
Yeah... In any case, we have to wipe out the Meganoids' forces fast...
Come out! Koros! Don Zauser!
Wh-What is going on... You!? Daitarn 3... Banjo Haran...!?
That voice... Koros!
...Nothing showed up on radar... How...
She seems caught off guard.
We should hit them all at once.
Striking while they're rattled is standard procedure.
And all at once.
All right, let's go!
Right...!
We're heading out too! Mike, Lenny!
Ah, wait a sec!
Just 'cause we're back on Mars, Big Bro's getting way too fired up.
Like it or not, Mars is home turf for us.
Don't fall behind Banjo! All hands, launch!
Aestivalis team, get ready too!
Huh... Akatsuki? You haven't been cleared for launch yet...
Hey, sorry about this. Something's come up I need to take care of.
I'll leave this to you guys. Well then, see ya!
Whaaat!? Hold on, Akatsuki, you can't just do that!
It's fine. Londo Bell is here, so even if the two of us drop out,
the operation will go just fine.
Even Erina... What on earth has gotten into them...?
(Hmm... Major Shiratori aside, it seems we'd best hurry things along.)
Captain, let's give up on those who left and hurry the operation along.
You're right... Okay then, once more, Aestivalis team, prepare to launch!
Earlier, I received a report that the ruins had become active...
So it was you. ...Just as I thought, those ruins...
Correct. ...Circumstances have forced us to borrow
your facilities. And while we're at it, I'm sorry to say...
Prepare yourself, Koros...!
...Very well, Banjo. I always felt that someday
we would have to settle things. That time has simply come...
Lady Koros, leave this to me.
Heh, here they come.
Looks like they came out in a real hurry.
...Looks like taking the fight to Mars was the right call.
Yes.
Now... let's settle this...!
I'll leave it to you. ...I expect you to strike down Londo Bell
splendidly.
Ohh... Lady Koros...!
Whoa! That many Neo Zeon mobile suits!?
Heh heh heh... Benmel dug these out of an old Neo Zeon base
and brought them here.
Like a bunch of thieves!
I don't like that way of doing things.
Them again, huh. Remodeled Megaborg robots.
These too, it seems. In such a pitiful state.
They're surprisingly useful. Even after death.
Your former comrades? ...Have you no shame!
Say what you like. ...Go, Commander Mylene.
Quit spouting all that crap! I'll damn well do it!
According to Dr. Inez, Major Shiratori has very little time left!
If this operation isn't finished within 10 minutes,
his life will be in danger!
The Meganoids' home base, in 10 minutes... Can we make it...!?
You idiot! It's not about whether we CAN make it,
we're GONNA make it! A hot-blooded man like Shiratori...
I won't let him die!
Hang on, Shiratori...! I won't let you die in vain.
Then let's go! For the world and its people, Daitarn 3 is here
to crush the Meganoids' ambitions! If you don't fear the light of this sun...
then come and get me!
...Banjo... y-you truly are...
Farewell, Koros...
B-Banjo... why won't you... understand the Don's heart...?
I hate...! My father, who created the cyborgs...
And for using my mother and brother in cyborg experiments... killing them...
I can never forgive him!
What'd ya say!?
...Banjo's got a past like that...!
At this rate... humanity will be ruined...
Why... why can't you understand that...
Spouting selfish garbage...!
Hyoma! Be quiet!
You and the Don, calling yourselves superhuman Meganoids... I hate that!
In an age when humanity takes flight into space... the Don's vision is right.
That's not for you to decide. If humanity is to be ruined... so be it.
The choice belongs to us humans...!
...What those humans... gave birth to... is us... the Mega...noids.
One... answer... that humanity produced...
My father used the wrong method... No, perhaps the method was right...
...But the result was wrong.
Dr. Haran... thought it through that far?
Dr. Saotome's the same, right? He's researching Getter Rays
for humanity's sake.
Then... are humans themselves not, by their very nature...
the ones who are unforgivable...?
Unforgiv... able.
...Excellen?
Perhaps so.
Master Banjo...
...You're a fine example, Koros. Your feelings for Don Zauser...
Love alone fills your heart, leaving you a Meganoid unable to think
of anything else...
Human... ego?
Loving him... is all I have. Answering his wishes...
is all I am...
You and the Don, calling yourselves superhuman Meganoids...
But power to satisfy one's own ego... has no place in this universe...!
Ah... my dear...
Oh... ooooooooooh!
Did we finally take out the Meganoid boss!?
Nobody walks away from damage like that...!
Banjo...! Banjooooo! You... You are the one...!
No... it can't... my... dear...
Korooooos... you...
How's that! Ilbora!
Nuooooh...!
Did we get him!?
The Zerokage!
...Ilbora!
P-Princess... forgive... me...
Did we get that ninja mech!?
It can't hold out much longer... It's going down...!
...Ilbora!?
So this... is the end. Princess... forgive me...
What are you saying!? Escape! Ilbora!
Betraying you, Princess... what was it I was trying to do?
...I don't really know myself...
Was it nothing but jealousy... or...
Ilbora...
...Joe.
...What?
...If we ever meet again... when that time comes... ugh...
Hang in there, Ilbora! ...We haven't settled this yet!
Big Bro...
Joe! Is there no way to save Lord Ilbora!?
Joe... take care of the Princess. The Princess...
Lady Koros!?
A Megaborg again!?
Yes... but the feel is different from before...
...Yes, so this is the moment of truth, is it, Koros?
I said there would come a time... when we must settle this, Banjo...
...So you did.
The likes of Londo Bell, we alone can...
And who keeps losing to the likes of Londo Bell, huh!?
A fair point. However... how about this?
They brought out something else!?
Tch, there's still more!?
Huh!? Hey, is that...?
RX-78... GP02A Physalis...! The Gundam GP02A!
Hmm... Why is it here?
Of all Benmel's collection, this robot has by far the greatest firepower.
...The nuke, humanity's cursed weapon. A fitting diversion for us,
wouldn't you say?
...You bastard...!
As usual, I bet it's been souped up like crazy...
Man, this really sucks!
Damn! We're in a hurry, and of course they've got reinforcements...
Aww, we don't have time for this!
Less talk, more action. ...The pain of losing someone dear...
...is better never felt...
That's...!?
Tch, that's Bancs, isn't it? Come to think of it, that bastard Hazard
was in bed with the Meganoids...!
But we already took Hazard out, right?
True... but we didn't beat every last one of the Za Boom bunch.
Which means, maybe...
Ilbora's... here? Where's he hiding...!
Doesn't look like they'll give us time to talk... Here they come!
A nuclear-armed Gundam... Is there some way we could capture it?
Lieutenant Uraki.
Huh? ...That might be tough. With an enemy carrying a nuke...
the only way is to take it down in one go with super robot attacks...
Shiro... don't push yourself too hard...
...What if I cut its power pipes with a beam saber on low output?
Remember, Aina? When we made a hot spring up on that snowy mountain.
...If we have the leeway, I'd like to try it, thinking ahead...
Only if we have the leeway, though...
That leaves... only Don Zauser.
He hasn't come out... I wonder where he is?
If he's not here, he's not here. Let's just get into the base already!
Princess Romina!
What...? That's...
More enemy reinforcements?
I've been waiting, Londo Bell.
Ilboraaa! You're still gonna struggle!?
Heh... It seems the Meganoids have no future left either...
but I will settle things with you!
Ilbora...!
Princess Romina, words won't get through to this guy!
...Fine, Ilbora, I'll settle this here and now!
Yep, yep, everyone's doing great! We'll make it in time! Right?
I do hope so...
Captain Misumaru, optimism is fine, but don't get careless.
...Ugh... uuh...
Huh...? Hey, Koros is over there!
...My... dear...
Looks like she's still breathing. But the state she's in, she won't last...
Koros... who is it... that hurts you...
Whoa!? Wh-What is that!?
D-Don... my dear... you've awakened...
I'm so... glad...
Koros... who was it that hurt you?
Well now... Master Banjo, it seems the star of the show has arrived.
My dear...
Uoooooooooooh!
That's...!
Whoa! You can see right through to his brain! His brain! Kyosuke!
Quiet. Banjo, is that...!?
...Yes, the Meganoids' boss... Don Zauser...!
Banjo...!
It's huge...! This is...!
So this is the Meganoid Dr. Haran created... in its final form...!
So that's the Meganoid leader... It seems my luck hasn't
run out just yet. This is far from over, Londo Bell!
For both sides... this is the moment of truth.
My dear...
I... see. I understand now... It was you
who always... made Koros sad...!
Don Zauser...!
For the sin of saddening Koros... for the sin of hurting Koros...
you shall pay for it all...! Banjo!
...Master Banjo.
We did it. Big Bro Banjo, this means the Meganoids
are finished, right?
And this time we finished him off properly...
He won't be coming back a second time. What a relief.
That's one more down... But it's still far from over, isn't it?
That's right. ...Banjo?
...I hate this...
You just don't quit, do you! Go crawl back wherever you came from!
I have nowhere left to return to! ...But Joe, I will settle things with you!
Tch! Fine, bring it on, you blockhead!
Nowhere to return to...?
Wonder why? Sure, we beat Charm and Hazard,
but...
...Ilbora, stop this at once!
Princess Romina...!?
...I want no more pointless fighting...
I am your enemy, Princess Romina...
Then do it. Shoot down the Elshank, and
it will all be over...!
Wha...!
Hey, hey! Are you outta your mind!?
That's crazy! Get back!
Commander!
Hey, shouldn't we stop her!?
I'm sorry... everyone. Now, Ilbora...!
Ngh, Princess Romina...!
This is way too reckless! Ilbora! I'm your opponent!
...The Ilbora Saro I knew was never that kind of man...
That's right! Lord Ilbora! Please come back!
...After all this... How could I come crawling back now...
You of all people should know the Princess's heart isn't so narrow,
should you not!?
Accepting an enemy without a shred of doubt... Poor form for a military.
True. But that's Londo Bell, isn't it?
Will it get through to him...?
...I can't say. But it's a dangerous gamble.
A gamble's more fun with bad odds... but this...!
Princess, you've got way too much nerve...!
...Princess Romina... But... I...!
Ah... Ilbora...
Lord Ilboraaa!
Ilbora... Trying to look cool all on your own, you bastard...!
Joe...
Ah! Show!
Hm!? Is that... Ilbora, was it!?
No doubt about it. He must've been thrown from his machine!?
What...!?
Recover him, quickly!
Is he alive!?
...I don't know. But...
Garrison, please hurry and bring him aboard. We've still got work to do.
Understood. I shall do my very best.
...We couldn't save him.
Nothing's more of a pain than a man's pride. ...Tch.
You idiot... Ilbora...
Is it over!?
Yeah, looks like there are no enemies left!
All right, stay on alert. Medical and assault teams, take the landing craft
into the base! There's no time! Hurry!
It's okay... We only went a few minutes over...
It'll be okay...!
It's okay... We wrapped it up in time...
It'll be okay...!
There may still be soldiers inside the base,
so I'll go too.
We're going too! Jet, Drill!
Right, leave it to me!
All riiight! If any walls get in the way,
I'll bust right through 'em!
Hurry!
Domon, hurry up!
Make haste, Domon! Don't dawdle!
Leave the small fry to us and find the medical room, quickly!
Wow... If I were the enemy,
I'd totally stay out of their way...
Search all of Mars and you probably won't find anyone who could...
I hope they make it in time...
All we can do now is leave it to the assault team...
Please... let Shiratori be saved...
Shiratori... I've still got so much more to talk to you about...
The assault team has entered the base.
Obtained the Gundam GP02A.
